rules.maxDamage: † Deal maximum damage with an attack

rules.one: 1 → Fall unconscious for d4 rounds; then awaken with d4 HP.
rules.two: 2 → Roll a d6: 1-5 = Broken or severed limb. 6 = Lost eye. Can't act for d4 rounds; then become active with d4 HP.
rules.three: 3 → Haemorrhage: death in two hours unless treated. All tests are DR16 the first hour; then DR18 the last hour.

occult_herbmaster.red_poison: Red Poison: Toughness DR12 or -D10 HP.
occult_herbmaster.ezumiel: Ezumiel's Vapor: Pass a DR14 test or severe (and arguably fun) hallucinations for D4 hours.
occult_herbmaster.frog: Southern Frog Stew: Vomit for D4 hours, pass a DR14 test or you can do nothing else.
occult_herbmaster.vitalis: Elixir Vitalis: Heals D6 HP and stops infection. Can be habit-forming.
occult_herbmaster.soup: Spider-Owl Soup: See in darkness, climb on walls for 30 minutes.
occult_herbmaster.philtre: Fernor's Philtre: Translucent oil, must be dabbed right into the eye. Heals infection and gives +2 on Presence tests for D4 hours.
occult_herbmaster.hyphos: Hyphos' Enervating Snuff: Berserk! Two attacks per round but defend with DR14. Lasts one fight. Must be snorted, causes sneezing.
occult_herbmaster.black_poison: Black Poison: Toughness DR14 or -D6 HP and blinded for one hour.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

whatIsMorkBorg.a: MÖRK BORG is a doom metal album of a game. A rules-light, art-heavy tabletop RPG about lost souls seeking redemption in a bleak world. The game is published by Free League Publishing.

whatIsScvmGrinder.a: Scvm Rack is a free character sheet and generator for MÖRK BORG. It helps you create characters, track stats, and manage equipment during your games.

isItFree.a: Yes! Scvm Rack is completely free to use. You can create and save characters without paying anything.

guestVsAccount.a: No account needed to start. As a guest, you get one character — generating a new one replaces it. Characters are kept for 7 days. Sign up (free) to keep unlimited characters permanently, accessible from any device.

howToSave.q: How do I save my character?
howToSave.a: Characters save automatically as you edit. As a guest, your single character is stored for 7 days. Sign up to keep it permanently and create more.

multipleCharacters.a: With an account, yes — create and switch between as many characters as you like from the Scvms menu. As a guest, you get exactly one. Generating a new scvm replaces the current one.

mobileSupport.a: Yes! Scvm Rack is designed to work on phones, tablets, and desktops. Use it at the table or on the go.

offlineUse.a: Currently, Scvm Rack requires an internet connection. Offline support may be added in the future.

knownIssues.a: A couple of inventory quirks we're still polishing: identical items stack together to keep things tidy, but editing one item in a stack while also changing its quantity can occasionally apply the edit to the wrong copy. Workaround: edit the item first, then change the quantity separately. A cleaner fix that keeps stacked items as individuals is on the way.

bugReport.q: I found a bug! How do I report it?
bugReport.a: Found something broken? Open a bug report here with what happened, or use GitHub issues if you prefer a public trail. Every report helps keep Scvm Rack sturdy.

howCanIHelp.a: You can support the project on Buy Me a Coffee: https://ko-fi.com/tackgnols_rpgtools. Every contribution helps keeping the rack alive!

faq.morkBorgCredit: MÖRK BORG is copyright Ockult Örtmästare Games and Stockholm Kartell. This is an independent fan project.

privacy.title: BLOOD OATH
privacy.subtitle: Data, Tracking, and Storage Notice

sections.storage: Browser storage is required for core operation. We store technical and gameplay data on your device, including language settings, session flags, active character references, and privacy preferences.
sections.backend: Character and gameplay content that you enter in this app is transmitted to and stored on our backend services, including guest sessions. This storage occurs even if you do not create an account.
sections.analytics: If analytics is enabled below, Google Analytics is used to process usage events and page activity. You can disable analytics at any time without losing core app functionality.
sections.sensitiveData: Do not enter sensitive personal data in character fields. By continuing to use this app, you acknowledge and accept this notice.

privacy.analyticsEnabledState: Analytics is currently enabled. You may disable it now or later in this panel.
privacy.analyticsDisabledState: Analytics is currently disabled. Core app features continue to work.
privacy.consentConfirmation: Selecting "{{action}}" confirms your agreement to this notice.

release.title: Release Notes
release.moreUpdates: More updates coming soon. The world is ending, but we keep shipping.

v043.partyNameContrast: Party-name text on the GM overview now stays black on yellow so it remains readable while creating a party
v043.partyNameLimit: Party creation now checks party names in the browser and blocks submit above 100 characters
v043.localizedFeedback: The party-name validation message is localized in English and Polish

v042.lanternConsumable: Lanterns and torches show up in the Consumables section with their use pips and count toward encumbrance again, instead of being treated as ammunition
v042.sourcebookLink: The "Get the sourcebook" button now points to the Polish edition at nerdsirens.pl on the Polish view
v042.translationCredit: Footer credits the official Polish translation by Nerd Sirens

v041.itemSearch: Equipment search now returns Polish item names on the Polish view instead of English ones
v041.dates: The character list now formats dates in the active language
v041.partyEscape: A player whose only scvm is already in a party can now leave it — or roll a fresh scvm — straight from an invite link
v041.livePulse: The GM warband strip gives a quiet, motion-safe flash on a scvm when its values change live
v041.creationPolish: Creation flow: the re-roll button and stat names/abbreviations are localized, and re-rolling one section no longer flashes every button
v041.langUrl: Opening /pl/... or /en/... sets the language, then continues to the page

v040.parties: Game masters can create a party, share an invite link, and have players bind a scvm to the table
v040.liveUpdates: The GM overview and player party view stream changes live — HP, stats, and who is connected — without refreshing
v040.creation: A guided character creation flow: pick a class, go classless, or roll random, preview the scvm, re-roll any section, then forge it
v040.polish: Polish is re-enabled with a redesigned header language toggle and broad localization across the app

v035.characterUrls: Generating or selecting a scvm now lands on the clean /character/<id> URL without stale character query parameters
v035.trailingSlash404: Opening /character/ now shows the 404 page instead of an empty app state
v035.plainTextSaves: Character text saves now keep apostrophes and punctuation as typed instead of returning HTML entities

v034.authButtons: Account controls in the header are now clearly labeled buttons (Logged In / Log Out / Log In) instead of bare icons
v034.listLocale: The character list and its dates now display consistently in English, matching the English-only app

v033.firstRun: First run no longer creates a character before you accept the storage notice — an animated loading skeleton shows while your sheet is prepared
v033.englishOnly: The language switcher is temporarily removed; the app is English-only for now while translations are reworked
v033.faqCredit: Fixed the FAQ copyright credit to match the rest of the site
v033.hardening: Hardening: utility URLs no longer return the app shell, plus a new production release checklist

v032.editorSaves: The character sheet now saves reliably during fast, back-to-back edits — no more lost or reverted changes
v032.inventory: Fixed unequipping armor and item edits; different items that share a name no longer merge into one stack
v032.sharePreview: Shared links now show a proper preview card, and the site ships a sitemap for search engines
v032.knownIssues: Added a "Known issues" section to the FAQ
v032.internals: Backend restructured into clear layers and character generation hardened (no behavior change)

v030.engine: Character generation now runs in-app via a seedable roller instead of database randomness
v030.reads: Fetching and saving characters no longer depends on database stored procedures
v030.alphaPrep: Internal cleanups ahead of the public alpha

v021.alpha: Added an Alpha badge to the Scvmrack title
v021.openSheet: Hardened Open Sheet so fast clicks use a safe bootstrap route
v021.authorLink: Linked the Adam Kościelniak production credit
v021.deployPackaging: Fixed deploy packaging to ship built frontend static files

v020.errorDialog: Automatic dialog to report unexpected errors
v020.tests: Hardened automated test suite (unit, integration, end-to-end)
v020.tooling: Tooling fixes: green test run and a working linter
